name: Lychee Liqueur
description: A sweet fruit liqueur made by infusing or macerating lychee fruit into a neutral spirit base, then sweetening. It has a delicate floral, grape-like sweetness with a light musky aroma and low bitterness. It is used in cocktails such as the Lychee Martini and tropical or sparkling drinks, often paired with vodka, gin, or sake.
